title: [research tooling] Concurrent writers to research/queue/*.yaml strand PRs: dispatcher last_dispatched_at stamps and research-queue-grade blocks conflict with hand-grade PRs, and vice versa
note: MEASURED 2026-11-20: (1) hand-grade PR #27745 conflicted twice in ~40 min with dispatcher stamp commits (last_dispatched_at at 09:00Z and 09:07Z on 4 units); each needed a manual merge of main and a full CI cycle (~15 min). (2) research-queue-grade run 44697854258 failed: its output PR #27735 hit failed_conflict for 80 min because W47b's hand re-grades of 9e1c-12/abab-28/abab-29 landed in between. ML-15 fixed both by hand (merge main, keep the newer hand grade). Candidate fix: write last_dispatched_at and auto-grade blocks to a sidecar (e.g. research/queue/.state/<id>.json) that hand-grades never touch, or have the automation refresh step resolve stamp-only conflicts by taking both sides. Gates this adds or changes: none. 2026-11-20 14:30Z AM-OPS-11 (manager-directed note). SAME CLASS, on the grader side. research-queue-grade's 'Land the dispositions on main' step (commit-to-main verify-merged) failed or was cancelled at its ~80-min merge wait in 3 runs: 44480035240 (2026-11-19 07:33-08:54Z, failure), 44533148252 (2026-11-19 13:32-14:53Z, failure), 44694465506 (2026-11-20 07:40-09:12Z, cancelled). Grading still converges because a later grade run lands the same deterministic dispositions (#27735 11:38Z and #27795 13:39Z on 11-20; queue_grade.py on main = 0 changed). Each miss raises a run-failure alert (e.g. 11-20 10:38Z) and leaves a research-store-bundle that the loss detector's question C flagged (detector fix #27809).
